title: Agent
description: Frontmatter schema for persistent agent definitions under src/apothem/agents/. Reconciled to the Anthropic Claude Code subagent canonical format (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents#supported-frontmatter-fields): only `name` and `description` are required; multi-word optional fields use camelCase; unrecognized fields are accepted as metadata.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier (lowercase letters and hyphens). The filename does not have to match.

description.description: When Claude should delegate to this subagent (one to two sentences).

tools.description: Tools the subagent may invoke. Inherits all tools if omitted. Accepts a comma-separated string or a JSON array.

disallowedTools.description: Tools to deny, removed from inherited or specified list. Accepts a comma-separated string or a JSON array.

model.description: Model selection: `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, a full model ID (e.g. `claude-opus-4-7`), or `inherit`. Defaults to `inherit`.

permissionMode.description: How the subagent handles permission prompts.

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of agentic turns before the subagent stops.

skills.description: Skills to preload into the subagent's context at startup.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers available to this subagent. Each entry is either a server name (string) or an inline definition (object).

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, etc.).

memory.description: Persistent memory scope: `user`, `project`, or `local`. Boolean `false` is accepted as the explicit no-memory marker; omit the field to inherit defaults.

background.description: Always run this subagent as a background task when true. Default: false.

effort.description: Effort level when this subagent is active. Overrides the session effort level.

isolation.description: Set to `worktree` to run the subagent in a temporary git worktree.

color.description: Display color for the subagent in the task list and transcript.

initialPrompt.description: Auto-submitted as the first user turn when this agent runs as the main session agent.

version.description: Apothem extension: SemVer version of the agent definition.

updated.description: Apothem extension: ISO 8601 date of last revision.

portability.description: Apothem extension: portability classification across harness adapters (e.g., `universal`, `claude-code-only`).
